name: Tai Sin Electric Limited
summary: Established in Singapore in 1980 and headquartered there, Tai Sin Electric Limited is engaged in the comprehensive design, development, production, and sale of a diverse range of cable and wire products. The company conducts its operations through distinct segments: The Cable & Wire division supplies essential power, control, instrumentation, and fire-resistant cables, alongside busbar trucking systems, catering to various electrical and instrumentation needs within commercial, residential, industrial, and infrastructure developments. The Electrical Material Distribution segment offers an extensive portfolio including industrial control systems and components, sensing products, measurement and monitoring solutions, power quality systems, as well as safety, cabling, and electrical accessories, and lighting and energy monitoring solutions. These offerings serve a broad spectrum of industries, particularly industrial automation, maintenance, repair, and operations. The Switchboard segment specializes in manufacturing switchgears, encompassing low voltage main and sub-switchboards, distribution boards, and control panels, designed for deployment in large buildings and industrial installations. The Test & Inspection segment provides expert consultancy, testing, inspection, and certification services for construction materials such as concrete, soil, and asphalt premixes. Beyond these core areas, the company also participates in general construction, technical engineering, oil and gas ventures, non-construction activities, and the distribution of electrical products. Tai Sin Electric Limited serves a wide array of clients, including end-users, contractors, manufacturers, system integrators, engineers, and consultants, with its market presence spanning Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, Vietnam, Indonesia, Myanmar, Cambodia, Thailand, and other international regions.
